name: Tasks
description: The tenant's to-dos in one place, as a library app other apps require (Mail, the Nexus, the CRM): projects with their people, statuses ordered as a board's columns, tasks ordered within their status with assignees, dates, priority, labels, checklists and comments, and tasks agents propose until a person accepts them. Forge's Tasks app shows them.

commands.title: New project
commands.description: Makes a project, its target the new project's id: its name, key, description, members and guests (user ids); its maker administers it, and the app gives it the statuses To do, Doing, Review and Done.

commands.title: Set a project up
commands.description: Run by the Tasks app when a project is made: gives it its four statuses. Only the app may.

commands.title: New task
commands.description: Makes a task in a project, its target the new task's id, last in its status: title, description, assignees, dates, priority, labels, parent and source. An agent whose autonomy is suggest makes a proposal; with draft, a task.

commands.title: Change a task
commands.description: Changes the fields given of a task (the target): title, assignees, due, start, priority, labels; given a status of its project it moves there too.

commands.title: Move a task
commands.description: Moves a task (the target) to a status of its project between the tasks it was dropped between (after, before), setting or clearing when it was completed.

commands.title: Complete a task
commands.description: Moves a task (the target) last into its project's first done status, with when it was completed.

commands.title: Accept a proposed task
commands.description: Makes a task an agent proposed (the target) an active task.

commands.title: Dismiss a proposed task
commands.description: Archives a task an agent proposed (the target).

queries.name: projectTasks
queries.description: A project's board: the project, its statuses in order, its active tasks in order, its labels and its proposals. params {project}

queries.name: myDay
queries.description: The viewer's unfinished tasks due by today, their others, and the proposals for them. params {today?}

roles.title: Tasks manager
roles.description: Sees and changes every project, its tasks and its people

roles.title: Tasks user
roles.description: Makes projects (administering each) and sees the projects that name them as an admin, member or guest; a project's tasks need a role on it, which the app grants

rowRules.tasksProject: principal.user in map(concat(record.admins ?? [], record.members ?? [], record.guests ?? []), string(#))

roles.title: Project admin
roles.description: Granted on one project by the app to its admins: changes the project, its people, statuses and labels, and every task, checklist and comment in it

roles.title: Member
roles.description: Granted on one project by the app to its members: reads it, makes and changes its tasks, checklists and labels, and comments
roles.agentWarning: An agent that is a member may make and change every task of the project

roles.title: Guest
roles.description: Granted on one project by the app to its guests: reads that project alone, comments, and changes its tasks' status

triggers.title: A project was made
triggers.description: Sets a new project up as the app (project.setup): its statuses To do, Doing, Review and Done.

triggers.title: A project's people changed
triggers.description: Keeps a project's grants equal to its admins, members and guests: enqueues the project's grant sync, one at a time per project.

tools.name: create
tools.title: Create a task
tools.description: Makes a task in a project, as the caller: title, status, description, assignees, due date, priority and source. From an agent whose autonomy is suggest it is a proposal a person accepts.

tools.name: update
tools.title: Change a task
tools.description: Changes a task's title, assignees, dates, priority or status, as the caller; an agent's run changes only the tasks it is about.

tools.name: list
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: Lists the tasks the caller may see, by project, assignee (me) and state, with the caller's projects and their statuses.

tools.name: comment
tools.title: Comment on a task
tools.description: Adds a Markdown comment to a task, as the caller; an agent's run comments only on the tasks it is about.
